about.title: TOOLOR — a modern clothing brand from Kyrgyzstan
about.philosophyP1: TOOLOR makes clothing for people who never stand still — between the city and the open trail. Function, clean lines and the character of Kyrgyzstan live in every detail.
about.philosophyP2: We dress people who value freedom of movement, quality and things that last. Not about passing trends — about movement you can be yourself in.

principles.functionText: Every detail is designed for movement — pockets, fit and fabrics that work in real life.
principles.designText: Calm lines and a restrained palette. Pieces that are easy to combine and wear every day.
principles.characterText: We draw on the mountains, the light and the rhythm of our land — and carry it into the clothing.
principles.durabilityText: Quality materials and an honest cut with nothing extra. Pieces that last more than one season.

about.statementText: We believe good clothing doesn't restrain you — it helps you move further, confidently and without excess.
about.ctaText: The new TOOLOR collection is in the catalogue — for the city and the open trail.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: We deliver across Kyrgyzstan and abroad.
delivery.p1: Delivery across Bishkek and the regions of Kyrgyzstan, plus international shipping. Timing and cost depend on the destination and are calculated at checkout.
delivery.p2: Once your order ships we'll send a tracking number. For any delivery question, write to us — we'll help you pick the most convenient option.

returns.title: Exchange and returns
returns.description: If a piece doesn't fit, we'll help you exchange or return it.
returns.p1: You can return or exchange an item within 14 days of receiving it — provided it keeps its original condition, tags and packaging.
returns.p2: To start a return, write to info@toolorkg.com with your order number and we'll suggest the easiest way.

stores.title: Find TOOLOR
stores.description: We work online and deliver across Kyrgyzstan.
stores.p1: TOOLOR is currently available online: choose your pieces in the catalogue and have them delivered anywhere in Kyrgyzstan or abroad.
stores.p2: We're preparing our first offline points in Bishkek. Addresses and opening hours will appear here — follow us for updates.

sustainability.title: Built to last
sustainability.description: Considered materials and pieces that live longer.
sustainability.p1: We choose technical and natural fabrics, clean lines and a cut designed for movement — so the clothing lasts and stays comfortable every day.
sustainability.p2: Fewer trends, more meaning: we make pieces you come back to season after season.
